risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.summary: The risk of asset impairment, particularly goodwill, is high due to the sensitivity of their value to changes in interest rates and market conditions, especially for the International and Foodservice reporting units.
risks.score_rationale: The impairment risk is high due to the significant value of goodwill ($2,065 million) and the sensitivity of asset values to changes in interest rates and market conditions. The International and Foodservice reporting units have only a 2% and 18% margin, respectively, above their carrying value.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: Interest rate risk is high due to exposure to 28% floating-rate debt and the potential impact on asset fair value and financing costs.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate changes, with approximately 28% of total debt subject to floating rates. An increase in interest rates would reduce discounted cash flows and negatively impact the fair value of reporting units.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Volatility
risks.summary: Foreign exchange risk is moderate due to the company's international presence with over 100 sites across 20 countries.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 20 countries and is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations. In 2025, favorable currency movements contributed $57 million to revenue changes.

risks.title: Tax Regulation
risks.summary: Tax regulation risk is moderate due to the complexity of tax rules and reliance on federal tax credits to reduce the effective tax rate.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to complex tax regulations and benefited from $8 million in federal tax credits in 2025.

risks.title: Asset Depreciation
risks.summary: Asset depreciation risk is moderate due to facility closures and associated impairment impacts.
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded a $9 million reduction in accelerated depreciation in 2025 related to facility closures. Future depreciation risk exists due to ongoing facility closures (Middletown in May 2025, East Angus in December 2025).

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.summary: Market competition risk is moderate due to the highly competitive packaging market with numerous players using different materials.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market and competes on innovation, price, and execution capability. The 2% decline in revenue reflects volume and pricing pressures.

risks.title: Supply Chain and Commodity Inflation
risks.summary: Risk from inflationary pressures on materials, energy, and labor is high and reduced operating income by $153 million in 2025.
risks.score_rationale: The company faced $47 million in inflation on purchased materials, energy, and logistics in 2025, partially offset by savings on recycled fiber. Labor and benefits inflation added $106 million in additional costs.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.summary: Litigation risk is low due to the absence of significant disclosures regarding ongoing legal proceedings.
risks.score_rationale: The company did not disclose any significant litigation in the provided 10-K.

ai_positioning.summary: GPK does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
